So this state produces NO native refusal -- verified per branch by rejection_events_before_step == rejection_events_after_step with native_refusal_counted_on_this_step False -- which is exactly why the rejection-phase census can report 0 refusals across 11,060 map decisions and still be consistent with map states that have no successors.
